The Canadian Dream

People speak less often of a “Canadian Dream,” but many Canadians would describe it differently. It tends to emphasize:

* A good quality of life.
* Universal health care.
* Political stability.
* Safety and relatively low levels of violence.
* A strong social safety net.
* Multiculturalism and tolerance.
* Work-life balance.

Economic success certainly matters in Canada, but it is often viewed as one part of a broader vision of well-being rather than the central goal.
